notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first ends at «حدثنا محمد بن جعفر» before «ح»; the second runs «أبو بكر بن نافع ... غندر» after it
The names written once after the last «ح» (from «شعبة» on) are the shared tail, appended to both branches (rule 3); «- واللفظ له -» is a gloss and is left out
«محمد بن جعفر» and «غندر» are kept as two links, not merged (rule 9)
